description: This file defines the FeedBody class within the Goteo Library, responsible for rendering feed items with appropriate links and colors, and managing feed-related data structures.

classes.name: FeedBody
classes.description: A class for generating and rendering feed items, including links and colored labels, for the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a FeedBody instance with given type, id, label, and variables.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the feed item as an HTML string, resolving nested FeedBody instances.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Generates HTML for a link or span representing a feed item, styled according to its type.

methods.name: getVar
methods.description: Retrieves a variable value from the instance's vars array.
